Taiwan Speciality Chemicals.why: Makes electronic-grade disilane and trisilane CVD deposition gases used at 7nm and below and anhydrous HF dry-etch gas, and through its 65.22%-owned subsidiary cleans and plasma-spray coats CVD / etch chamber parts used at 5nm / 3nm; advanced-node fab ramps drive its volumes.
Taiwan Speciality Chemicals.evidence: Taiwan Speciality Chemicals annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-13-2026): its main product, high-purity disilane for CVD dielectric silicon films, has been applied in 7nm and lower-node advanced semiconductor processes; AHF was formally introduced into the customer supply chain in 2025; 2026 disilane shipments are expected to keep growing strongly as key customers' new advanced fabs ramp.
